task.maid_odyssey.clean_muffler.desc: Empties the ash out of nearby GregTech muffler hatches.
task.maid_odyssey.clean_muffler.desc_2: The ash goes into her backpack, or is destroyed if configured that way.
task.maid_odyssey.maintenance_hatch.desc: Repairs broken GregTech maintenance hatches nearby.
Put a wrench, screwdriver, soft mallet, hard hammer, wire cutter and crowbar in her backpack.
task.maid_odyssey.gt_housekeeping.desc: Cleans muffler hatches and repairs maintenance hatches, both at once.
task.maid_odyssey.gt_housekeeping.desc_2: Needs tool room in her backpack for both jobs.
message.maid_odyssey.muffler.cleaned: Collected %s ash from the muffler hatch.
message.maid_odyssey.muffler.voided: Threw away %s ash from the muffler hatch.
message.maid_odyssey.muffler.backpack_fu: My backpack is full, I cannot take any more ash out of this muffler hatch.
message.maid_odyssey.maintenance.repaire: Fixed %s maintenance problem(s) on this hatch.
message.maid_odyssey.maintenance.duct_ta: Patched %s maintenance problem(s) with duct tape.
message.maid_odyssey.maintenance.missing: I have no tool for this maintenance hatch, still missing: %s
message.maid_odyssey.gt.not_installed: GregTech Modern is not installed, so there is nothing for me to look after.
message.maid_odyssey.gt.api_mismatch: I cannot talk to GregTech Modern: %s
message.maid_odyssey.unreachable: I cannot get close enough to work on this machine.
message.maid_odyssey.hazard.flee: That spot would poison or burn me, I am staying clear.
